questions.question: What horror of the siege does Lamentations 4 describe?
options: A deep and lasting peace that settled over the whole of the land
A great and abundant feast that filled up every single house
A rich harvest that wholly overflowed all of the storehouses
Famine so severe that the people starved and suffered terribly
questions.answer: Famine so severe that the people starved and suffered terribly

questions.question: How does Lamentations 4 describe the former nobles compared to now?
options: Once very poor and lowly, but now lifted up high in great honor
Once purer than snow, now blacker than soot, unrecognized
Once scattered far abroad, but now gathered back home again
Once entirely silent in their grief, but now singing aloud for joy
questions.answer: Once purer than snow, now blacker than soot, unrecognized

questions.question: Lamentations 4 says the punishment of Zion's iniquity was accomplished.
The tongue of the nursing infant sticks to the roof of its mouth for _____.
It was for the sins of her _____ and the iniquities of her priests.
